Attach proof of age, Aadhaar copy, proof of UP residence and self-attested copies of all mark sheets and certificates.
Send the complete application to Dr. Ashish Gupta, Principal Investigator, Department of Civil Engineering, BIET Jhansi, to reach on or before 30-11-2026.
Alternatively, email scanned copies of the application and all documents in a single PDF file to [email protected].
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid if called for the interview Self-attested copies (or scanned, if sent by email) of all relevant certificates must be submitted with the application Clarifications on the application process can be sought from the Principal Investigator at [email protected]

content_sections.heading: BIET Jhansi Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. CST-UP(6676)/CED/BIET Jhansi/2026 – 03 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download BIET Jhansi notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B.E./B.Tech./M.Tech. in Civil Engineering with 1st Division (with strong background in Geotechnical Engineering/ Foundation Engineering); Preference to candidates with M.Tech. (Completed) in Geotechnical Engineering, or Structural Engineering, or allied areas; Indian Citizens who are resident of Uttar Pradesh Age limit: Below 28 years (as on 1 April 2026) Age relaxation: As per CST UP Norms Other conditions: Applicant should be an Indian citizen resident of Uttar Pradesh Eligibility as per Council of Science & Technology, U.P. General Information and Guidelines for Award of Research-Assistantship and Grant-in-aid Regulation – 1988 Desirable: Expert hands-on with Deep Learning, Graph Neural Networks (GCN, GAT, GraphSAGE, Graph Transformers) and Explainable AI Strong proficiency in Python, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, or similar ML frameworks Experience with database handling, model training, and performance evaluation Working knowledge of PLAXIS, Abaqus, or other numerical simulation tools Prior research publications in Machine Learning, Soil Mechanics, Foundation Engineering will be an added advantage Good written and verbal communication in English

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Position is purely temporary and coterminous with the project Emolument for 14 months; project duration two years, of which 10 months are already completed Candidate is expected to join immediately, if selected

content_sections.heading: How Will BIET Jhansi Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting by the selection committee Interview Selection committee may restrict candidates called for interview based on qualification and experience higher than the minimum prescribed Only shortlisted candidates will be communicated to appear in the interview Tentative interview date 05-12-2026 at 03:00 PM; any change will be communicated

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Recent passport-size photograph affixed on the form Proof of Age (preferably High School Certificate) Copy of Aadhaar Card Proof of Residence of Uttar Pradesh Self-attested copies of all mark sheets and certificates

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BIET Jhansi Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format (Annexure-1), printed on page 4 and downloadable from https://www.bietjhs.ac.in. Affix a recent passport-size photograph on the form. Attach proof of age, Aadhaar copy, proof of UP residence and self-attested copies of all mark sheets and certificates. Send the complete application to Dr. Ashish Gupta, Principal Investigator, Department of Civil Engineering, BIET Jhansi, to reach on or before 30-11-2026. Alternatively, email scanned copies of the application and all documents in a single PDF file to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid if called for the interview Self-attested copies (or scanned, if sent by email) of all relevant certificates must be submitted with the application Clarifications on the application process can be sought from the Principal Investigator at [email protected]

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BIET Jhansi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in BIET Jhansi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Junior Research Assistant (JRA).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for BIET Jhansi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-1 (page 4 of this PDF); also downloadable from https://www.bietjhs.ac.in) and send it to Dr. Ashish Gupta, Associate Professor, Department of Civil Engineering, Bundelkhand Institute of Engineering and Technology Jhansi, Jhansi – 284128, Uttar Pradesh, by application must reach the principal investigator at the address; or scanned copies by email as a single pdf, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 28 years (as on 1 April 2026). Relaxation: As per CST UP Norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 28,000 per month (fixed emolument) for 14 months.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.E./B.Tech./M.Tech. in Civil Engineering with 1st Division (with strong background in Geotechnical Engineering/Foundation Engineering); preference to M.Tech. (Completed) in Geotechnical Engineering, Structural Engineering or allied areas; Indian citizens resident of Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant should be an Indian citizen resident of Uttar Pradesh. Eligibility as per Council of Science & Technology, U.P. General Information and Guidelines for Award of Research-Assistantship and Grant-in-aid Regulation – 1988.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting by the selection committee. Interview. Selection committee may restrict candidates called for interview based on qualification and experience higher than the minimum prescribed. Only shortlisted candidates will be communicated to appear in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Position is purely temporary and coterminous with the project. Emolument for 14 months; project duration two years, of which 10 months are already completed. Candidate is expected to join immediately, if selected.
